profile.headline: Software Developer | Vue Typescript Golang
profile.summary:
Builder of software, at least one house, some furniture, about a dozen relief shelters, among other things. 
Currently building frontends for Ahold USA focusing on performance, developer experience, and decreasing delivery time.

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
- Led a greenfield modernization of a core web application using Nuxt, establishing
organizational standards for TDD and a fully tokenized design system.
- Decoupled a legacy system from Webpack/Spring Boot/Nginx into a modular
service, migrating to Vite to achieve near-instant developer feedback and saving over 10 hours per month in developer productivity. 
- Implemented modernization efforts such as increasing test coverage and reducing bundle size of the frontend codebase which decreased LCP score from 4.3 to 2.2 as well as increased lighthouse from 24 to 73.
- Led implementation efforts to increase 4% points in 90 days our overall customer satisfaction scores.
- Discovered customer satisfaction bottlenecks by finding and replicating recurring errors with Datadog, and implemented their frontend solutions with test-driven complex reusable components with Vue 3, Jest, Tailwind CSS.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Code Review · HTML · Tailwind CSS · Vue.js · Jest

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
- Designed the entire architecture as well as the visual UI, from schematic to implementation of the frontend with Vue 3 composition api, backend with Golang, and smart contracts with Solidity along with the automated testing suite for each.
- Mentored new developers to their first OSS contributions.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Develop interactive software that applies the latest trends in instructional design to create interactive online university programs.
- Create and audit accessible web interfaces to ensure ADA compliance.
positions.insights: Skills: SCSS · ADA Compliance · JavaScript · TypeScript

positions.title: Owner & Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Created a company that grew from 0 to 5k in Monthly Recurring Revenue through sales by creating partnerships with restaurants.
- Translated domain specific operations to a working custom full-stack application written in Vue.js and Laravel.
- Conducted user interviews to iterate through UX problems and prioritize tasks for development of the application.
- Created a logistics framework for administrative operations such as handling inventory, accounting, and marketing efforts.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Test & Automation)
positions.description:
-	Automated 20% of regression tests through automation testing tool with Java, Selenium, and JUnit directly reducing release testing cycles by 40 man hours.
-	Improved development and testing productivity by creating and maintaining a Postman API testing suite.
-	Achieved a full month without high priority issues in production by implementing thorough testing practices and automated feedback processes.

positions.title: Software Automation Engineer
positions.description: Realized a 20% reduction in testing time for healthcare products by architecting a robust automated testing framework using Java and Selenium. Developed testing standards for ensuring HIPAA compliant access control.

positions.title: Design Architect for Social Impact Projects
positions.description:
- Secured several contracts for SolisColomer through designing and presenting master plans, residential, and commercial spaces for organizations and individuals in Guatemala.
- Introduced modern design processes and computational methods to increase building and design efficiency.

positions.title: Design Thinking Fellow
positions.description:
Helping with the creation and implementation of  design thinking "workshops" to teach a multidisciplinary audience about human centered design mindsets for social innovation. 

Remade graphic material - flyers, etc- to help promote the programs hosted by Taylor.

Worked with other teams to create marketing material and content to promote design thinking related programming at Taylor.

Helped in the planning and programming of an immersive weekend experience focused around helping a community partner - PlayBuild - in their initiative to bring play materials to the neutral ground in Central City.

positions.title: Public Interest Design Fellow
positions.description:
Working with a group of student fellows to conduct research about topics of interest in the built
environment. 

Used a combination of quantitative and qualitative research and analysis in order to produce a report which describes and makes graphic the landscape of mental and behavioral health resources available to schoolchildren in New Orleans. The research was a combination of Geographic Information System mapping and a process of interviews from people experiencing different levels of involvement to not only describe what exists, but incorporate how perceptions and values also affected access to and the effectiveness of the process.

company.name: Small City Center at the Tulane School of Architecture

positions.title: Drafter
positions.description: Short experience working as a drafter, helping with the programming of a new LAX airport terminal.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Designed a housing construction manual for volunteer relief efforts. 
Led groups of 10-15 volunteers at a time in the a coordinated disaster relief housing construction building 8 temporary shelters.
Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GQOWOIJKx0CQaDh6at7rqs9L7HABU9Cb/view?usp=sharing
